# ReKit (rekit.tools)

> Free, client-side, 100% private file and conversion utilities. All processing runs in the browser with zero server uploads.

## Image Tools
- /jpg-to-word: Convert image text into an editable Word document (DOCX) using on-device OCR.
- /image-to-pdf: Merge one or multiple images (JPG, PNG) into a single PDF file.
- /image-to-text: Extract text from any image using on-device Tesseract.js OCR.
- /image-resizer: Resize images to any custom pixel dimension or percentage.
- /image-compressor: Compress images to reduce KB size while preserving visual quality.
- /image-converter: Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, and BMP formats.
- /image-watermark: Add custom text or image watermarks to photos locally.

## PDF Tools
- /pdf-to-text: Extract text from PDF files quickly and accurately.
- /pdf-to-word: Convert PDF documents into editable Word (.docx) files.
- /pdf-to-images: Convert PDF pages into JPG or PNG images.
- /pdf-merge: Combine multiple PDF files into one document in browser memory.
- /pdf-split: Split a PDF into individual pages or custom page ranges.

## Text Tools
- /text-to-pdf: Convert plain text into a formatted PDF document.
- /text-to-word: Convert plain text into a formatted Word DOCX file.
- /text-to-image: Convert text into a downloadable PNG or JPG graphic.

## Developer & Productivity Utilities
- /word-counter: Count words, characters, sentences, and estimated reading time.
- /case-converter: Convert text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, kebab-case.
- /base64: Encode or decode text and binary files using Base64.
- /json-formatter: Format, validate, and minify JSON data instantly.
- /qr-generator: Generate custom QR codes for URLs, contact details, or text.
- /password-generator: Generate cryptographically strong random passwords.
- /url-encoder: Encode or decode URL parameters and query strings.
- /uuid-generator: Generate cryptographically random UUID v4 identifiers.
- /lorem-ipsum: Generate placeholder dummy text by paragraphs, words, or lists.
- /hash-generator: Generate cryptographic hash checksums (SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512).
- /color-converter: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, RGBA, and HSLA formats.
- /csv-to-json: Convert tabular CSV data into structured JSON objects.
- /markdown-preview: Live preview of GitHub-flavored Markdown rendered to HTML.
- /text-diff: Compare two text blocks with added and removed line highlighting.
- /base-converter: Convert numbers between Binary, Octal, Decimal, and Hexadecimal.

## Blog & Guides
- /blog: Practical guides and tutorials on client-side conversion, compression, and developer utilities.
- /blog/convert-jpg-to-word-without-uploading: How to convert JPG to editable Word without uploading files.
- /blog/merge-multiple-pdfs-in-browser-privately: How to merge multiple PDFs privately in browser memory.
